title: Stage by stage
body: Open each stage for what happens there.

hotspots.label: Fetch or push
hotspots.detail: Connectors fetch data, including permissions. A custom connector pushes instead, from wherever it runs; Glean places no constraints on where that is.

hotspots.label: Parse
hotspots.detail: Item content such as title, body, comments, and media is parsed together with permissions.

hotspots.label: Process
hotspots.detail: Processing verifies identities and access data and waits for required dependencies. Glean expands derived groups and memberships.

hotspots.label: Index and graph
hotspots.detail: Connectors populate the index plus identity and permission structures; the graph layers structure and signals on top of that data.

hotspots.label: Query
hotspots.detail: The runtime chooses index, live, or hybrid paths per request. Retrieved snippets are passed to the model to condition the answer.
